profile: Learns best from pictures and short explanations.
Struggles with long paragraphs of text.

cases.message: Draw the water cycle for me.
Show me how photosynthesis turns light into sugar, step by step, with a drawing.
Draw a comparison of mitosis and meiosis.
Draw a tree of how animals are classified: mammals, birds, fish, and a couple of examples of each.
Draw an animal cell and label its main parts.
Draw what happens when my browser loads a web page, from typing the address to seeing the page.
Draw the graph of y = x^2 - 4 and show where it crosses the x axis.
Use a drawing to show why 2/4 is the same as 1/2.
